personalInfo.name: KAMBDETEY Lionel
personalInfo.title: AI Engineer
personalInfo.bio: Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision Engineer, passionate about creating innovative technological solutions that combine performance with real-world utility. My journey has led me to develop advanced video analysis systems, multi-camera tracking, and self-trainable document recognition (OCR), as well as high-impact mobile and web applications. Driven by curiosity and the desire to learn, I continuously explore AI, AR, and full-stack development, with a vision focused on entrepreneurship and scientific research. My goal: to design technologies that improve daily life and inspire the future.
